text: This report submits the draft 2019 financial statements for approval. The financial statements were reviewed by the Policy & Finance Committee at its meeting of 2020-07-08 and were recommended for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the draft financial statements of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo for the year ended December 31, 2019, attached as Attachment 1 to the report (July 10, 2020) from the Director, Finance and Technology, Toronto Zoo.
